incoming.name: Hungary
incoming.excerpt: Dishes are often flavoured with paprika (also Hungarian for pepper).

outgoing.name: Scurvy
outgoing.excerpt: In 1932, the Hungarian scientist Albert Szent-Györgyi, using Vitamin C from a red pepper, proved that scurvy was caused by Vitamin C deficiency.
